The addition of Mo element to LRHEAs can hinder the formation of Zr-rich precipitates, thus enhancing the phase stability of LRHEAs at intermediate temperature.

When the Mo content is raised from 0 to 7 %, the strength of the alloy increases from ~760 MPa to ~1079 MPa, resulting in a strength enhancement of ~42 %, showing excellent solid solution strengthening effect.
